CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportSsN @CentrumID INT, @OpeNumer INT AS -- Naglowki SELECT SsN_GIDNumer, SsN_TStampDataStop, SsN_Streszczenie, SsN_Opis FROM CDN.OpeKarty JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyNag ON Ope_PrcNumer=CWN_Obsluga JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElem ON CWE_GIDTyp=4180 AND CWN_Id=CWE_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElemObiekty ON CWE_GIDNumer=CWO_CWENumer AND CWE_GIDLp=CWO_CWELp JOIN CDN.Slowniki ON CWE_RodzajId=SLW_ID AND SLW_Predefiniowany=28 JOIN CDN.SrsNag ON SsN_GIDTyp=CWO_ObiTyp AND SsN_GIDNumer=CWO_ObiNumer WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND CWN_Aktywny=0 AND CWN_ZewnetrznyId<=0 AND CWN_Stan=2
-- Elementy SELECT SsE_GIDNumer, SsE_GIDLp, SsE_GIDLp As SsE_ElementLp, SsE_ElementTyp, SsE_OpeStartNumer As SsE_OpeNumer, 1 As SsE_KnSNumer, SsE_Tytul, SsE_Opis FROM CDN.OpeKarty JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyNag ON Ope_PrcNumer=CWN_Obsluga JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElem ON CWE_GIDTyp=4180 AND CWN_Id=CWE_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElemObiekty ON CWE_GIDNumer=CWO_CWENumer AND CWE_GIDLp=CWO_CWELp JOIN CDN.Slowniki ON CWE_RodzajId=SLW_ID AND SLW_Predefiniowany=28 JOIN CDN.SrsNag ON SsN_GIDTyp=CWO_ObiTyp AND SsN_GIDNumer=CWO_ObiNumer JOIN CDN.SrsElem ON SsN_GIDTyp=SsE_GIDTyp AND SsN_GIDNumer=SsE_GIDNumer AND SsE_GIDLp=SsE_GIDLp WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND CWN_Aktywny=0 AND CWN_ZewnetrznyId<=0 AND CWN_Stan=2
SELECT SsE_GIDNumer, SsE_GIDLp, SsE_OpeStartNumer As SsE_OpeNumer, 0 As SsE_KnSNumer, SsE_Tytul, SsE_Opis, SsE_DataWykonania FROM CDN.OpeKarty JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyNag ON Ope_PrcNumer=CWN_Obsluga JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElem ON CWE_GIDTyp=4180 AND CWN_Id=CWE_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.CRMWizytyElemObiekty ON CWE_GIDNumer=CWO_CWENumer AND CWE_GIDLp=CWO_CWELp JOIN CDN.Slowniki ON CWE_RodzajId=SLW_ID AND SLW_Predefiniowany=32 JOIN CDN.SrsElem ON SsE_GIDTyp=CWO_ObiTyp AND SsE_GIDNumer=CWO_ObiNumer AND SsE_GIDLp=CWO_ObiLp AND SsE_ElementTyp=2 WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND CWN_Aktywny=0 AND CWN_ZewnetrznyId<=0 AND CWN_Stan=2
